hero.subheadline: Designers and studios worldwide enter brand and communication work
hero.valueProposition: Winners receive a Kaleidoscope trophy, electronic award certificates, touring exhibition features, and promotion across Hiiibrand's media channels.

content.whyJoin:
The Hiiibrand International Brand & Communication Design Awards 2026, the 17th edition organized by Hiiibrand, celebrates outstanding brand practices and design excellence. The awards comprise the Brand Awards, honoring companies and organizations for achievement in brand positioning, strategy, innovation, and communication, and the Design Awards, recognizing teams and individuals for excellence in communication design.

For the 2026 edition, the awards introduce a new AI Visual category, encompassing brand visuals, motion visuals, and experiential visuals created through meaningful collaboration between human creativity and artificial intelligence. Parallel professional and student tracks give established practitioners and emerging designers the chance to present work to an international jury of veteran designers.

Entries are assessed beyond surface aesthetics. Brand Awards judging considers brand story and vision, strategy, innovation, and identity, while Design Awards judging examines communication, execution, creativity, and long-term influence. Winners of the Bronze Award or higher receive a Kaleidoscope trophy, electronic certificates are provided free of charge, and winning and shortlisted works may be featured in touring exhibitions.
content.whoShouldApply:
The awards are open globally to professional agencies, studios, design teams, marketing departments, freelancers, and rights-holding brands, as well as graduate, undergraduate, college, and technical-school students. Professional entries must be commissioned and actually applied, while student entries may be graduation projects or school assignments.

Work must have been created or published between January 1, 2024 and August 31, 2026. AI Visual entries must demonstrate at least 30% substantive AI involvement, with the tools, process, and human-AI collaboration disclosed.

This call suits brand designers, agencies, and students who want international recognition, a professional benchmark, and a platform to showcase their best brand and communication design work.

faq.question: Who can enter the Hiiibrand Awards?
faq.answer: The awards are open globally to professional agencies, studios, design teams, marketing departments, freelancers, and rights-holding brands, as well as graduate, undergraduate, college, and technical-school students.

faq.question: How much does it cost to enter?
faq.answer: Design Awards fees vary by level and category. Regular fees are $80 for professional Branding and $40 for student Branding, with other categories at $48/$80 for professional single/series and $24/$40 for student single/series. Super early bird and early bird periods offer 50% and 25% savings. Brand Awards entry is free.

faq.question: What are the key deadlines?
faq.answer: The Super Early Bird deadline is June 30, 2026 with 50% savings, the Early Bird deadline is July 31, 2026 with 25% savings, and the regular deadline is August 31, 2026. All deadlines are 23:59 UTC/GMT+0.

faq.question: What categories are available?
faq.answer: The Design Awards cover Branding, Logo, Packaging, Typography, Editing & Publishing, Advertising, Environment & Space, Digital Media, and the new AI Visual category, each with professional and student levels.

faq.question: What do winners receive?
faq.answer: Winners of the Bronze Award or higher receive a Kaleidoscope trophy. Electronic certificates are free, winners may use the official awards logo, and winning and shortlisted works can feature in touring exhibitions and media promotion.

faq.question: When are the results announced?
faq.answer: Judging runs in three rounds from September 2026 to March 2027, with shortlists announced in January 2027 and winners announced in March 2027.

submissionGuide.detail: Choose your category and level, and download the appropriate entry form from the Hiiibrand website. Confirm your work was created or published between January 1, 2024 and August 31, 2026.
Send the completed entry form along with image and video files to the committee by email. The committee replies within 5-7 working days to assist with completing the submission and payment.
Complete payment according to your chosen deadline. Fees are discounted 50% during the Super Early Bird period and 25% during the Early Bird period.
An international jury evaluates entries in three rounds, with second-round candidates asked to provide additional information.
Shortlists are announced in January 2027 and winners in March 2027, with awards including Gold, Silver, Bronze, and Merit distinctions.
